Research Git and TEI together

Diagnosis: Understanding patterns. Prevention: developing suitable tests. Evaluation: checking their impact and stress.

Investigate a location

Git pale, show and diff

The line history provides an introduction to the last assigned change. Previous levels and differences can then be read specifically and connected with annotation, check deduction and correction note.

Note: No automatic cause identification. Deleted or replaced lines and previous changes require further comparisons. The associated name is not proof of individual guilt.

git blame · git show · git diff

First overview

Git Quick Stats

Displays statistics about commits, files and activity. Samir checks first which areas and time periods deserve a closer look.

Note: No TEI semantics. Imports, bots, renamings and mass formatting can shape the image; statistics do not explain its causes.

Project and application examples

Targeted report

Gitinspector

Creates historical repository reports and can be limited to selected file types. For TEI files, Samir XML must explicitly include in the file filter.

Note: Standard reports are person-oriented, XML is not included in the default file filter. A XML output file of the report is not an analysis of the TEI meaning.

Project and documentation

See on the team

Gource

Visualizes the development of a repository as a moving file tree. For a workshop, the growth and change of editing can be illustrated.

Note: A vivid animation is not a proof of quality. Names and activity can become visible; also the joint demonstration needs an clarified scope.

Project, examples and setup

Connect Git and TEI

PyDriller

A Python library to run commits and modified files. Samir can connect previous and later file contents with its own XML checks.

Note: Custom scripts and technical definitions are required. Built-in code/method metrics are not TEI quality measurement. Consider missing content, renamings and merge strategy.

Documentation on modified files · Project and start-up

Check the XML page

Jing, Schematron, XPath and XSLT

Jing checks against a RELAX-NG-schema. Schematron formulates additional rules. XPath selects elements and attributes; XSLT can generate structured comparisons, reports, and outputs.

Note: These are different tools and languages. Regular version, context and test run are documented. A formally valid reference can show the wrong technical position.

♪ Jing ♪ · Schematron · XPath

Complementary exploration of patterns

CodeScene / Code Maat

Hotspots or jointly modified files provide search directions. Samir compares them with the professionally classified correction cases.

Note: Code health assessments are not transferred to TEI. A frequently changed area can show intensive scientific work instead of poor quality.

CodeScene: Product and Tour · Code Maat

Where there is a greater need

GrimoireLab

Can merge data from Git, processes and review systems and access them as dashboards. Interesting when a pilot creates a well-founded permanent need.

Note: More setup and care; the linked data also allow deeper personal insights. Do not precautionably collect all available sources.

Project, supported sources and entry

A limited pilot: understand, improve, check

1. Inventory and clear question

Choose one to three suitable repositories and comparable time periods. Start with a small overview and mark imports, bots, renamings as well as changed commit practice. Before evaluating purpose, data scope and access clarify.

2. Connect Git and TEI results

Check the same subsets against the appropriate schema and project rules. Investigate historical stands with PyDriller and XML evaluations. Match familiar problem cases with comparable stable areas; distinguish professional decisions from error corrections.

3. Try out actions and early indicators

Three to five abnormalities with alternative explanations and prioritized measures persist. Test improvements in a targeted manner. Check a possible early indicator only at later periods, not used for its development; detect false alarms and overlooked problems. No standard edition health score.

The tools are explained and linked here, not executed on project data. Data sources, historical personal references, access and opposition path are clarified before the pilot.
